sop_thesis: **The ONE Group Hospitality (STKS)** operates in Consumer Discretionary (Restaurants) with an established market capitalization of $45.13M. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Brand Equity, Omnichannel Logistics Scale & Customer Loyalty.
